facts.fact: The Nigerian Case Management System was introduced at the Supreme Court in 2012 and, per the Chief Justice in the 2025/2026 legal year, is being progressively adopted as an official nationwide platform developed under the National Judicial Council.

The Chief Justice says all backlog cases in the High Courts are being uploaded into the NCMS, and the Supreme Court is moving to e-filing integrated with it, with a module still being developed and no launch date.
The Federal High Court said manual filing of new cases in its Lagos Division ends April 24 and the e-filing platform becomes operational from April 27, with all new filings exclusively electronic.
